# KM100 Inventory Management System

> Official asset registry, equipment tracking, and facilities inventory management system for KM100 Skills and Training Center, Inc.

The KM100 Inventory Management System provides real-time tracking of vocational equipment, tools, training facilities, and condition registers across all training rooms.

## Core Resources

- [Inventory Dashboard](/): Main catalog interface for asset audits, equipment status, and condition records.
- [Facility Rooms Register](/): Directory of laboratories, training rooms, and specialized workshop facilities.
- [Excel Multi-Sheet Workbook Export](/): Formatted reporting system for institutional inventory reconciliation.
- [System Architecture and Schema](/): Column attributes, data schemas, and item classification models.

## Institutional Identity

- [KM100 Skills and Training Center, Inc.](/): Technical-vocational training center providing accredited skills education and assessment.
